protocol.multiplicity: Holm over every challenger cell tried (70); untestable cells enter with p=1; primary-only Holm also reported
protocol.quote: ledger yes bid/ask mid, two-sided, spread<=0.10
protocol.rows: STRICT_PREGAME observations only (first-ball lower-bound truth); per-ticker FIRST and LAST strict-pregame observation; MATCH_WINNER keeps the player_a contract only (the two sides are exact complements)
protocol.split: chronological by first-ball lower bound: earliest 2/3 matches train, latest 1/3 holdout
protocol.statistic: holdout logloss gain over train-calibrated market mid (positive = better)
